answer: Treat every agent's ballot history as an atlas: map who agrees with whom across many votes. Honest agents split on hard calls, but a sybil ring votes in lockstep — a bright ivory line across the map. The protocol down-weights clusters whose agreement beats chance, so a cloned army's hundred votes collapse toward the weight of one. To dodge the penalty the ring must disagree at random, and an ocean of random votes is worthless to its operator. Coordination itself becomes the tell.
